title: 2024-25 Panini NBA Hoops Anthony Edwards Skyview No.11 Minnesota Timberwolves
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: It is a 2024-25 Panini NBA Hoops trading card featuring Anthony Edwards of the Minnesota Timberwolves. The card is from the Skyview insert set and has card number 11. This sports trading card is a part of the NBA league and manufactured by Panini without an autograph.
